page: Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor configuration delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs. To accommodate workloads requiring elevated memory ceilings, the instance includes 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Graphical acceleration is absent, directing all compute operations strictly through dedicated CPU execution pipelines.

A key architectural component of the Endv6 family is integrated low-latency disk capability. The instance features 1,888 GB of local NVMe SSD storage bundled directly with the compute configuration, in addition to supporting Azure Premium Storage. The server is also classified as network optimized. The integration of high-capacity local NVMe storage provides strong resource density and cost efficiency by eliminating the immediate need for external block storage when handling high-speed scratch space or temporary database buffers.

Given the hardware profile of high memory capacity, dedicated processor allocation, and fast local NVMe storage, Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is engineered for data-intensive workloads. Suitable deployments include large-scale enterprise relational databases, distributed in-memory data structures such as caching tiers, business analytics engines, batch ETL pipelines, and high-throughput backend services.
description: Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine operating on Microsoft Hyper-V and powered by dedicated Intel x86_64 processors. Designed with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of RAM, it maintains an allocation ratio of 8 GB memory per vCPU. The instance incorporates 1,888 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage, while featuring network-optimized connectivity. It does not include discrete GPU hardware, focusing core capacity on compute and memory throughput. The integration of high-density memory and fast local NVMe storage provides practical resource efficiency for workloads that require large memory footprints and local low-latency scratch space without relying entirely on remote network storage. Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is suitable for enterprise relational databases, in-memory caches, large ETL processing jobs, and high-concurrency transactional systems.
